summary: #smallpoems Drips condense, fall to tunes of crackling ice beating out a two-step shanty Sugar squeezed from sunlit runs in tart pains of labor Aint know best lemonade Expect recipe you got Lemonade no competition more a Goal A way of being getting there before you know its gone
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
#smallpoems
Drips condense,
fall
to tunes
of crackling ice
beating out a two-step
shanty

Sugar
squeezed from
sunlit runs
in tart pains
of labor

Aint know
best lemonade
Expect recipe you got

Lemonade no
competition
more a Goal
A way of being
getting there
before you
know its gone
